notes.title: A.I. Space Corps goes Final Release
notes.content:
We are proud to announce that A.I. Space Corps completed its Early Access phase and is now available as full version! Many new features, missions and locations made it into the game.

http://store.steampowered.com/app/423180

A.I. Space Corps is a top-down space shooter taking place in the far future universe of A.I. Invasion. As the captain of a space ship it is your duty to defend bases, transmit intelligence through enemy sectors and reclaim occupied stations. Can you survive the dangers of outer space and fight back the merciless A.I.?

[u]Full list of features[/u]
[list]
    [*]3 different ships with distinct attributes
    [*]flexible weapon upgrades throughout missions
    [*]strategic gameplay through various board systems like secondary weapon or temporary shields
    [*]different merciless enemy robots that have to be approached strategically
    [*]various challenge missions and Steam leaderboards to compete on
[/list]

The A.I. Space Corps Team

notes.title: A.I. Invasion goes gold!
notes.content:
[h1]We are proud to announce that A.I. Invasion completed its Early Access phase and is now available as full version! Many new features, missions and locations made it into the game.[/h1]

Take on the role of a soldier fighting against the merciless A.I. machines controlling the universe. Traveling the Rimae planetary system you command a team that has to overcome various missions to defeat those pesky metal roaches. Utilize a wide range of weapons and even special items that aid you in battle! Can you reclaim the system from the A.I.?

http://store.steampowered.com/app/386540/

[h1][u]Full list of features[/u][/h1]
[list][*]full story campaign telling the story of the reclamation of the Rimae planetary system
[*] 20 varied missions with a wide range of objectives
[*] 9 different environments on several planets and even in space
[*] 6 unlockable main weapons with different shooting behaviors and projectile types
[*] 5 unlockable special items, that serve as equippable special abilities
[*] control up to 5 special units to approach combat strategically
[*] full gamepad support
[*] Steam Achievements[/list]

Additionally many minor improvements, bugfixes and smaller feature additions mark the transition of A.I. Invasion from Early Access to full release. So, see you on the intergalactic battlefield!

The A.I. Invasion Team

notes.title: A new update for Fermi's Path is live!
notes.content:
[h1]Fermi's Path keeps improving for free![/h1]

We finalized the level editor. You can now add [b]Tokens, Explosives, Gates and a secret path[/b] to your custom levels. With these features added, the level editor is complete and it is possible to design fully fleshed out levels which can compete with levels designed by our team! Some more new features made it into the editor as well. We updated the comprehensive level editor guide and recommend you to have a look before getting your hands dirty:

 [url]http://www.fermis-path.com/wp-content/uploads/2015/05/FP_Workshop_Guide.pdf[/url] 

Additionally, along with various bug fixes, we improved the GUI and unlocked the Steam cloud feature to allow save files to stay synchronized with all your devices.

[b][u]Most important changes/additions[/u][/b]
[list][*]added Steam cloud save feature
[*] added animations to Fermi on level start & level end
[*] added a level end music
[*] added loaded profile hint to main menu
[*] added Gamepad button hints to level selection
[*] added Tokens, Explosives and Gates to the level editor
[*] unlocked copy/paste functionality in the level editor
[*] improved achievement detection especially for save files created with the demo version
[/list]

So jump onto the path and work on those highscores, touch up the custom level you have in mind and stay tuned for the features we have planned for you next :)

The Fermi's Path Team

notes.title: Fermi's Path Workshop now available!
notes.content:
Hey subatomic travelers! Today we have some big news for you.

[h1]The Fermi's Path Workshop is now live![/h1]
[img]http://cdn.akamai.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/apps/342650/f1fabd2b84db4fd061aac6ced703ddac6ba556d3.jpg[/img]

As you may have noticed while looking through the level editor shipped with the game, the "Export to Workshop" feature was disabled. Not anymore! You can now share your custom levels with all the other highscore hunters out there!

Before you jump into the action we recommend reading through the Fermi's Path Workshop Guide. It goes through every basic step of creating a custom level for the game.
[url=http://www.fermis-path.com/wp-content/uploads/2015/04/FP_Workshop_Guide.pdf]Check it out here[/url]

If you wish to skip the fine print, atleast be advised to subcribe to the Workshop Example Level we prepared! It contains a basic level setup that shows you the in and outs of level building and path object logic.
[url=http://steamcommunity.com/sharedfiles/filedetails/?id=430029963]Check it out here[/url]

Do note that some hard to observe particles are still missing from the editor. Be assured that we are working hard to catch them ;)


[u]Additionally some more bug fixes[/u] made it into the game, most noticably:
[list][*]Gamepad compatibility was improved
[*]The game opens the pause menu when defocused while playing a level. This fix prevents the music from stopping mid-game.
[*]The camera no longer spins around the path when transitioning through a Gate object
[/list]

Good luck and accelerated collisions to you!

The Fermi's Path Team


PS: If you enjoy Fermi's Path, please consider leaving a positive Steam review to make other arcade game enthusiasts notice our subatomic cosmos!  ː8bitheartː

notes.title: Fermi's Path weekly Devblog 8
notes.content:
[h1]Music and Soundtrack[/h1]

[b][u]Fermi's Path is all about music![/u][/b] The game features a wide range of different music tracks. Every track determines Fermi's speed and the rhythm of a level. Precision and sense of tact are the key to success. 

To achieve accuracy, the game system perfectly adjusts every level to the speed of the current music track. As a result every single game object is accurately synchronized with a beat.

[url=http://www.fermis-path.com/wp-content/uploads/2015/04/Fermi_Beats.gif][img]http://www.fermis-path.com/wp-content/uploads/2015/04/Fermi_Beats.gif[/img][/url]

The same system will help players in creating beat-accurate custom levels which will feel like naturally woven into the music.
Do you have the rhythm in your blood? Fermi's music driven Path can also be challenged with a dance pad or similar input devices!

As always don't forget to also check out our social media channels to grab all new information about Fermi's Path!
https://www.facebook.com/fermispath 
https://twitter.com/fermispath 

The Fermi's Path Team

notes.title: Fermi's Path weekly Devblog 7
notes.content:
[h1]Level Objects #2: Gates and the secret paths[/h1]

On his rush across the subatomic path Fermi might encounter hidden, sometimes hard to reach, black holes – so-called [u][b]Gates[/b][/u]. 
Every Gate is a connection to a secret path that contains even more points but also dangers!

[img]http://www.fermis-path.com/wp-content/uploads/2015/04/Fermi_Gate.gif[/img]

If Fermi manages to find and complete the secret path he is transported back to the regular path to continue his journey from the point he left. In addition to the collectibles hidden behind a Gate, the player is rewarded with a batch of bonus points for every completion of a secret path. 


Fermi's Path closed beta launched last week! Would you like to check out player impressions and opinions surrounding the game? Keep yourself posted on our social media channels! 
https://www.facebook.com/fermispath 
https://twitter.com/fermispath 

The Fermi's Path Team

notes.title: Fermi's Path weekly Devblog 6
notes.content:
[h1]Enemies #2: More Hazards [/h1]

Alongside the enemy particles we already introduced, even more dangerous obstacles await Fermi on his travels!

The [u][b]Stomper[/b][/u] is a static particle that is stationed on one side of the path. It opens and closes in certain time intervals, switching between blocking and clearing the way. Players have to anticipate the right moment to slip through! Different combinations of placement and interval lengths pose an adrenaline induced challenge in the heat of the beat rush!

Another common foe is the so called [b][u]Collider[/u][/b]. Just like Fermi this speedy particle travels across the subatomic path with the difference that it moves into the opposite direction – directly approaching Fermi! As its name suggests this enemy is all about destructive collision. Fermi's only option is to avoid it before it impacts!

[url=http://www.fermis-path.com/wp-content/uploads/2015/03/Fermi_Collider_Stomper_Shot.jpg][img]http://www.fermis-path.com/wp-content/uploads/2015/03/Fermi_Collider_Stomper_Shot.jpg[/img][/url]

Don't want to miss the latest news and media about Fermi's Path? Keep yourself up to date by following our social media channels!
https://www.facebook.com/fermispath
https://twitter.com/fermispath

The Fermi's Path Team

notes.title: Fermi's Path enters Closed Beta
notes.content:
[b]The LHC particle accelerator in CERN continues operating this month. Suitably the Closed Beta of „Fermi's Path“ launches today![/b]

[img]http://i.imgur.com/6u3loej.jpg[/img]
While scientists look for new particles, you jump into the role of the subatomic particle Fermi on his journey across the energetic path.
The closed beta will only last a few weeks and will allow selected beta testers to put the game to the acid test. Some features are not included in the closed beta version. The following features will only become available with the final release of the game:
[list][*]Infinite mode
[*]Steam leaderboards
[*][b]Level editor[/b]
[*]Steam achievements 
[*]Steam trading cards 
[*]Steam workshop 
[*]Many more levels[/list] 

We look forward to the feedback of our testers. If you are one of the chosen few, grab your gamepad or keyboard and get going!

As soon as we have more news for you, we will inform you here!

The Fermi's Path Team

notes.title: Fermi's Path weekly Devblog 5
notes.content:
[h1]Collectibles #2: Defense & Combat [/h1]
Last week we talked about the first batch of different enemy types that endanger Fermi's journey. Entangled in the battle of particles, Fermi has to look out for his energy! 

Fortunately there are different collectibles that increase Fermi's survivability. [b][u]Energy charges[/u][/b] that reload his hit points are found on many levels. More rare but still hidden in some sections are [b][u]Shield charges[/u][/b] that grant invincibility for a short amount of time. 

[url=http://www.fermis-path.com/wp-content/uploads/2015/03/Fermi_Shield_Shot.jpg][img]http://www.fermis-path.com/wp-content/uploads/2015/03/Fermi_Shield_Shot.jpg[/img][/url]

There are also offensive tools that can be utilized. Fermi has a weapon at his disposal that can temporarily be improved with different kinds of [b][u]Weapon Upgrades[/u][/b] hidden on the path. Those upgrades allow Fermi to use more potent shooting behaviors for a limited amount of shots. The [b][u]Burst Upgrade[/u][/b] for example allows him to shoot 3 quick, consecutive shots instead of only one.

[url=http://www.fermis-path.com/wp-content/uploads/2015/03/Fermi_Collectibles.jpg][img]http://www.fermis-path.com/wp-content/uploads/2015/03/Fermi_Collectibles.jpg[/img][/url]

notes.content:
[h1]Enemies #1: Base Enemies[/h1]

On the path, the player might encounter enemy particles. The so-called [b][u]Statics[/u][/b] hold their ground and must be avoided or destroyed by Fermi. Some Statics might even start shooting a weapon when Fermi comes close. 

[url=http://www.fermis-path.com/wp-content/uploads/2015/03/Fermi_Enemies_Shot.jpg][img]http://www.fermis-path.com/wp-content/uploads/2015/03/Fermi_Enemies_Shot.jpg[/img][/url]

Another kind of hostile particles is the [b][u]Chaser[/u][/b] which – when encountered - starts floating in front of Fermi while shooting him. The time until it departs differs between the various kinds of Chasers. 


Don't want to miss the latest news and media about Fermi's Path? Keep yourself up to date by following our social media channels!

[url=http://www.fermis-path.com/wp-content/uploads/2015/03/Fermi_Enemies_Shot.jpg][img]http://www.fermis-path.com/wp-content/uploads/2015/03/Fermi_Enemies_Shot.jpg[/img][/url]

Another kind of hostile particles is the [b][u]Chaser[/u][/b] which – when encountered - starts floating in front of Fermi while shooting him. The time until it departs differs between the various kinds of Chasers.

notes.title: Fermi's Path weekly Devblog 3
notes.content:
[h1]Level Objects #1: Mobility[/h1]

Fermi travels along a four-sided path. He can change sides at will, jump – for example to avoid obstacles or to reach points - and even shoot particles to clear his way. On his journey he will encounter different objects that may help or hinder his progress. 

[b][u]Liftups[/u][/b] push him up and therefore allow him to reach heights he would not be able to reach with regular jumps. In this way, objects floating high over the path become accessible. 

[url=http://www.fermis-path.com/wp-content/uploads/2015/03/Fermi_Liftup_Shot.jpg][img]http://www.fermis-path.com/wp-content/uploads/2015/03/Fermi_Liftup_Shot.jpg[/img][/url]

The [b][u]Pusher[/u][/b] allows Fermi to float in midair after a jump or Liftup for a certain amount of time. It also doubles Fermis speed for the effect duration. 

Combinations of Pushers, Liftups and other special objects increase Fermis mobility and allow him to reach and stay on heights he would not be able to access with regular jumps. Strategic use of such effects allow him to overcome bigger and longer obstacles or even access collectibles that would be too far off otherwise.

notes.title: Fermi's Path weekly Devblog 2
notes.content:
[h1]Collectibles #1: Points and Tokens [/h1]
The hunt for the highscore is essential to the gameplay of Fermi's Path. To achieve a good result, the player has to [b][u]collect points[/u][/b], distributed all over the path. Collecting multiple points in a row starts a combo that increases the value of collectibles as long as it's uninterrupted. 

There are more collectibles that reward the player with points. [b][u]Tokens[/u][/b] for example are special objects hidden in places and/or heights difficult to reach for Fermi. If players manage to collect all 3 tokens placed in a level, they receive a package of bonus points in the score summary. 

[url=http://www.fermis-path.com/wp-content/uploads/2015/02/Fermi_PointsToken_Shot.jpg][img]http://www.fermis-path.com/wp-content/uploads/2015/02/Fermi_PointsToken_Shot.jpg[/img][/url]

notes.title: Fermi's Path weekly Devblog 1
notes.content:
[h1]General #1: Levels and Modes[/h1]
Fermi's Path is a classic arcade game that challenges the player to master a wide range of levels to progress. 2 game modes will be available on release:

The [b][u]Path-Mode[/u][/b] is the base game mode, that requires Fermi to finish a level without getting destroyed by obstacles or enemy particles. If the player succeeds in reaching the level end, a new level is unlocked for him to be challenged.

[i]Level selection concept[/i]
[url=http://www.fermis-path.com/wp-content/uploads/2015/02/Fermi_Level_Selection_GUI_Concept.jpg][img]http://www.fermis-path.com/wp-content/uploads/2015/02/Fermi_Level_Selection_GUI_Concept.jpg[/img][/url]

After finishing a level in Path-Mode, it can be challenged in the so called [b][u]Infinite-Mode[/u][/b]. In this game mode the level is looped, getting faster with every iteration until the player is not able to keep Fermi alive anymore. The highscore of this mode is submitted to the Steam leaderboards so that the player competes with rivals from all over the world.


The Fermi's Path Team
